free_tier.stated: 100 awake vCPU-hours a month on the Free plan, with up to 2 vCPU per box, 3 boxes running at once, 4 GiB of memory per vCPU, 5 GB of storage and one workspace that sleeps after 30 minutes idle; paused and idle time between tool calls is not billed, hours reset monthly and do not roll over, and Free is one per person. Sessions run up to 4 h. On Free, new boxes wait until next month when the hours run out.
free_tier.notes: The unit is awake vCPU-hours: a 2 vCPU box open 10 hours but awake 10% of the time uses 2 awake vCPU-hours. The headline $0.10/h in the operator list is the marginal rate beyond the included hours on paid plans ($0.05 per awake vCPU-hour, or $10 per 500-hour pack), not the Free price.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the metered unit is an awake vCPU-hour on a microVM, not a stored object; the Free plan includes 5 GB of storage for disks, snapshots, templates and objects together

retention.stated: A persistent workspace is included and sleeps when idle; the vendor does not state a day count for retention of a stopped sandbox. Unverified: retention period not stated on the pricing page.

egress.terms: Network access follows the plan and the organization's policy, with an egress allowlist the user controls; the pricing page states no egress volume allowance or per-GB price.

interface_detail: A REST API at api.sandscale.dev, a TypeScript SDK, a CLI, MCP tools for agents, SSH into workspaces, and a dashboard; sandboxes are Firecracker microVMs.
tooling: The user installs and runs the Sandscale CLI or calls the REST API from an agent; TypeScript SDK and MCP tools are provided.
chaining: 100 free awake vCPU-hours a month of Firecracker microVMs can run agent code that calls other records' inference or data APIs, with a separate object-storage record for artifacts that must outlive a sandbox.

limits.value: 100 awake vCPU-hours a month on Free; on paid plans usage beyond included hours is $0.05 per awake vCPU-hour or $10 per 500 awake vCPU-hours
Up to 3 boxes running at once on Free; up to 2 vCPU per box, 4 GiB per vCPU included; session length up to 4 h

limits_note: Free adds one workspace, 5 GB of storage and first 10 GB of snapshots and templates free; enterprise self-hosted or bring-your-own-cloud deployments are listed but are not the hosted offer priced here.
binding_note: The 100 included awake vCPU-hours run out before the 3-box or 4-hour session cap for a sustained user; on Free, new boxes then wait until next month.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-up form asks for Full name, Work email and Password with acceptance of the terms; the page says 'Verify your email address before you start sandboxes and workspaces. Unverified accounts are removed after 7 days.' A card is asked only for paid plans, which are billed 'by card through Stripe'.

reliability_note: Paid usage beyond included hours is off by default; on Free, new boxes wait until next month rather than stopping a running box. No written SLA is published for Free, and hours do not carry over.
confidence_note: The quota, hours-reset, concurrency, overage price and account fields are quoted from the first-party pricing page read on 2026-11-25, and the sign-up fields from the first-party sign-up page read the same day. Egress volume and retention periods are not stated, so those fields stay unverified rather than guessed.
